description: A mini-game the reader plays: guess the article's number on a slider, or pick the right answer from a few options. The game is where the answer is first revealed — the headline and dek must not state it. A wrong option is a guess, not a fact: it must not appear in the article, and it must be a near miss, within twice the nearest right answer (and at least half of it) — close enough that a reader could plausibly guess it, but never stated by the article.

answer.description: Guess-number only: the article number the reader guesses. Required when kind is guess-number. It must appear in the article.

correct.description: Quiz only: the right answers, as numbers. Required when kind is quiz; give a list, because a question may have more than one right answer (a price range has two ends). Every value must appear in the article, and every value must also be one of the options.

kind.description: Which game this is: guess the number on a slider, or pick the right answer from the options.

label.description: What the game is about, in a few words: "Snow in 24 hours" or "The IPO price". Any number in it must appear in the article, and it must not state the answer.

max.description: Guess-number only: the slider's ceiling. Required when kind is guess-number; it must be at or above the answer. A design choice, not a fact from the article, so the checker does not verify it.

min.description: Guess-number only: the slider's floor. A design choice, not a fact from the article, so the checker does not verify it. Leave it out for 0.

options.description: Quiz only: three or four numbers to pick from, in the shared unit. Required when kind is quiz. The right answers are listed again in `correct`; the rest are distractors — guesses, not facts — so this whole field is not checked against the article. The checker enforces the distractor rule instead: a wrong option must not appear in the article, and must be within twice the nearest right answer (and at least half of it).

reveal.description: Quiz only, optional: one short fact line shown with the result, the payoff for playing — for example the range the right answers come from and when it was set. Any number in it must appear in the article.

start_fraction.description: Guess-number only: where the slider starts, as a fraction of the range. A design choice, not a fact from the article, so the checker does not verify it.

step.description: Guess-number only: the slider's step. A design choice, not a fact from the article, so the checker does not verify it. Leave it out and the template picks one: the range divided by 60, rounded to one decimal.

unit.description: The unit shown with the values: " cm" or "$". Required for both kinds.

unit_after.description: True when the unit goes after the number ("42 cm"), false when it goes before ("$78").
